svg.title: Anatomy of a citation
svg.desc: A citation names a full commit, a path and a 1-based inclusive line range. TimelineXray cuts those lines from the git blob as bytes and records the byte range, the blob id, the SHA-256 of the blob and of the span, and whether the anchor text occurs inside the span. Example: commit 92f0918, home-mixer/params/param.rs line 347, span SHA-256 4b5c535d, anchor ClickWeight FOUND.
